correctness.rationale: In the smooth sextic of genus 10, the central Q8 involution fixes the line X=0 and isolated point [1:0:0], the latter excluded by X^6 coefficient. Restriction to the line is YZ(Y^4+Z^4)=0, giving six distinct points in the stated characteristics. Q8 has a unique order-two element contained in every nontrivial subgroup, so there is no additional ramification. On t=Y/Z the quotient V4 action is generated by t↦-t and t↦-i/t: the six points give three size-two Q8 orbits with cyclic C4 stabilizers. Riemann--Hurwitz 18=8(2g(Y)-2)+6·3 gives g(Y)=1 and three branch indices 4. Independent symbolic matrix substitution verified both generators preserve the full b,c family and group relations.
